$description: Token usage policy for generators. rawValueRestrictions keys are exactly the category keys of token-catalog.json.

enforcementLegend.enforced: A script fails the run if violated (named in enforcedBy). Every entry below is implemented in extraction/verify_all.py check [k] (colour provenance runs only while the source tree sits beside the package, otherwise it prints a WARN) and is exercised by schema/tests/adversarial_test.py.
enforcementLegend.convention: Documented rule that no script checks. Do not describe convention rules as validated.

enforced.rule: every $ref in semantic/component/layout resolves to an existing token
every foundation colour rgb triplet exists in public/styles/coda-main.css (skipped with a warning when the source tree is not beside the package)

convention: Generators reference semantic ids, not foundation ids
No raw hex/px/ms in generated output

color.rule: Never write a raw colour (hex/rgb/hsl) or a foundation colour id in generated markup; reference a semantic id (text.*, surface.*, border.*, accent.*) or a component.themed-block.* pair.

typography.rule: Only type-* classes named in the catalog (24 steps). No raw font-size/line-height/letter-spacing/font-family.

spacing.rule: Only the --spacing-N steps (spacing.0..12, 3half); no raw px margins/paddings/gaps.

radius.rule: Only radius.* tokens (rounded-md dominates). No raw border-radius values.

breakpoint.rule: Only md (800px) switches layout. Do not invent sm/lg/xl utility prefixes; lg: exists for exactly one utility.

elevation.rule: No box-shadow at all. Only z-index layers z-50 / header 55 / loading bar 1000 and the three documented blur values.

iconSize.rule: Icons/logos sized by icon-size.* tokens or spacing-step heights, never raw px.

motion.rule: Only the motion.* vocabulary (closed). Every section needs a reducedMotionFallback in its contract.

semantic.rule: Semantic ids are the API for generators; each must resolve to a foundation token in tokens/themes/light.json.
semantic.enforcedBy: extraction/verify_all.py [k]: every semantic id resolves through tokens/themes/light.json

component.rule: Component tokens are owned by component/section contracts; a PageSpec never sets them.

layout.rule: Content widths, block padding, grid gaps come from layout.* only.

overrides.statement: PageSpecs carry NO per-instance style or token-override field. Styling is owned entirely by the section and component contracts, so there is nothing in a PageSpec that could reference or override a token. No such field is invented here, and no PageSpec-level token validation or adversarial mutation exists for it (MASTER-GUIDE 3.21). Token-layer safety is checked at the catalog/policy layer instead (parity, ref resolution, colour provenance).
